subject: general
question: The floor of an office has dimensions 5 m × 3 m. The cost of painting the walls is ₹8,640 at the rate of 60/m². Find the height of the room (in m).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Area of four walls** = Total Cost ÷ Rate per m²

**Area** = 8640 ÷ 60 = 144 m²

**Lateral Surface Area** = 2 × (Length + Breadth) × Height

144 = 2 × (5 + 3) × Height ⇒ 144 = 16 × Height

**Height** = 144 ÷ 16 = 9 m

**∴ The correct answer is 9 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length (L)** of the office floor = 5 m

**Breadth (B)** of the office floor = 3 m

**Total Cost** of painting the walls = ₹8,640

**Rate** of painting = ₹60/m²

**Formula Used:**

1. Area of walls (Lateral Surface Area) = **Total Cost ÷ Rate**

2. Lateral Surface Area of Cuboid = **2 × (L + B) × h**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a6aa517eb9eac0fa356f0a8621986e39f7c6c3134af8ced8f6a31374422dbde.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of the four walls = 8640 ÷ 60

⇒ Area of the four walls = 144 m²

⇒ 2 × (L + B) × h = 144

⇒ 2 × (5 + 3) × h = 144

⇒ 2 × 8 × h = 144

⇒ 16 × h = 144

⇒ h = 144 ÷ 16

⇒ h = 9 m

**∴ The correct answer is 9 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Lateral Surface Area of a Cuboid

It represents the sum of the areas of the four vertical walls, calculated as 2h(L + B).

Total Surface Area of a Cuboid

It includes the area of all six faces: 2(LB + Bh + hL).

Volume of a Cuboid

The space occupied by the cuboid is calculated as Length × Breadth × Height (L × B × h).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside the room is given by √(L² + B² + h²).
